# masamune_flutter

**Tag**: mobile, state-management

## 简介

Module that provides the flutter support function of the Masamune framework. State management by PathMap, page management, etc.

## 官网

- 主页: https://mathru.net
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/mathrunet/flutter_masamune_flutter
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/masamune_flutter
